content: Waitlist/seat-promotion pattern: promotion must be decided inside the same append condition as the seat release, otherwise two releases can promote into one seat or an enrol can consume the freed seat while a promotion also lands. FIFO must be ordered by the store's sequence position, not a payload timestamp (ties and clock skew). The promoted event must be tagged with the course so concurrent enrolments collide with it. Head-of-line entries can be stale (student already enrolled) so promotion must skip ineligible entries.
